ValidationRule.description: Blocks marking a Quote Binding until account Finance Approval Phase is Approved/Not Required. Fires only on Is_Binding__c change to true (existing binding quotes unaffected). Mark-time counterpart to VR_QUOTE_21.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Is_Binding__c), Is_Binding__c = true, NOT(ISBLANK(Finance_Approval_Phase__c)), Finance_Approval_Phase__c <> "Approved", Finance_Approval_Phase__c <> "Not_Required" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is a Binding quote and Finance has not approved the customer yet. A quote can only be marked Binding once Finance Approval is Approved (or Not Required). Please complete Finance review first.
